messages.subject: Superscripts and Subscripts
parts:
Hi;

I want to have "Leaf net photosynthesis (Amax) µmol CO2 m-2 s-1" for y axis in a line graph.  I use the following code.

ggplot(ardsummary, aes(x=round, y=photo, colour=trt)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=photo-se, ymax=photo+se), colour="black", width=.1, poistion=pd) +
  geom_line(position=pd) +
  geom_point(position=pd, size=3, shape=21,  fill="white") +
  xlab("Time in weeks")+
  ylab("Photosynthesis"])

Can someone show me how to write the code?

Thanks in advance.

Nalaka

messages.author: f20966e9bc9cf5c7
messages.subject: Re: Superscripts and Subscripts
parts:
Dear Nalaka,

Please see ?plotmath.

I will meet you halfway (and fix a few things), the rest you have to
learn ;).

ggplot(ardsummary, aes(x=round, y=photo, colour=trt)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=photo-se, ymax=photo+se), colour="black",

geom_line(position=pd) +
geom_point(position=pd, size=3, shape=21, fill="white") +
xlab("Time in weeks")+
